page_title: Tabby - Opensource, self-hosted AI coding assistant

summary.name: Tabby
summary.one_liner: Tabby is an open-source, self-hosted AI coding assistant that offers code completion, an answer engine, inline chat, and data connectors as an alternative to GitHub Copilot.
use_cases: Self-hosting an AI code completion server for a team
Getting coding answers inside the IDE without leaving the editor
Using AI inline chat to collaborate on code
Keeping source code on-premises with an AI coding assistant
Enriching AI suggestions with documentation or config files
summary.what_it_does: Tabby provides AI code completion that aims to understand coding context and suggest code in real time, within the IDE. Its Answer Engine lets developers ask coding questions and receive explanations or examples without leaving the editor. Inline chat lets users talk to the assistant about specific code in the editor. Data Connectors (Context Providers) pull in external sources such as documentation, configuration files, or APIs to make suggestions more project-aware. The page says it runs on-premises or in cloud IDEs, supports consumer-grade GPUs, and needs no external DBMS or cloud services.
notable: Self-hosted and open source, with no external DBMS or cloud services required
Data Connectors pull in docs, config files, and external APIs as context
caveats: Team and Enterprise plans are needed for full features, per the page's plan listing
Specific pricing amounts are not stated on the page
